evaluation.source: California Department of Public Health (CDPH) website
evaluation.data_description: Lists specific hospitals with links to redacted 'Plans of Correction' (PDFs) describing 'Immediate Jeopardy' incidents, including medical device-related events like retained surgical items and equipment failures
evaluation.dashboard_info: Dashboard for newer adverse events (likely up to 2023 or 2024)
evaluation.detailed_records: Penalty documents updated through 2018; HAI reports through 2022

structured_data.sample_event_excerpt: The facility failed to ensure that the patient did not have a retained foreign object after surgery.

evaluation.verdict: The site provides detailed hospital-level incident data, but the reliance on unstructured, redacted PDFs for specific adverse event descriptions makes it difficult for an automated ingest pipeline without advanced OCR/NLP processing.
